market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI is trading near $101-106 in early May 2026 with recent week's high around $106.65. Strait of Hormuz blockage has driven elevated, volatile prices since February. With ~28 days remaining and intraday volatility, hitting $110 (only ~3-4% above recent high) is plausible but not certain. Geopolitical tail risk dominates.
